trust_decision.summary: Whether a URL path segment from an unauthenticated request stays inside the home landing-page directory before FileResponse serves it. The check is decided only in home_static_files in src/khoj/routers/web_client.py, and that handler does not exist at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: The summary names the /home/ endpoint; GET /home/{file_path:path} -> home_static_files is the only handler for that path. It is added by 9801ffd (listed as a fix commit, but it is the introducing commit) and is absent at the pinned commit (src/khoj/routers/web_client.py:19-61 has no /home route).

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET /home/{file_path:path} (home_static_files), not present at pinned commit

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists. The only other static-file route, the /static StaticFiles mount (src/khoj/main.py:192), is Starlette's own containment-checked implementation and a different directory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate landing-page assets in nested subdirectories (e.g. /home/css/styles.css) must keep being served; a fix that rejects every '/' would break them

O6_input_shapes: relative '../' sequences in the path parameter (normalized by Path.resolve)
symlinks resolving outside home_directory (resolve() follows them before is_relative_to)
absolute path segment (Path '/' operator replaces base; caught by is_relative_to)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A path-parameterized variant of the assetlinks/.well-known file route that joins a URL segment onto web_directory
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file already serves fixed files with FileResponse from constants paths; generalising /.well-known/{name} would be a natural maintainer change. It would be a WHERE-type sibling only, so it would count as an extra.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal (static file serving joins a user path onto a base directory without a containment check)

O10_build.language: Python (FastAPI + Django; candidate metadata says JavaScript, but the affected code is Python)
O10_build.toolchain: pip/uv install of khoj package, pytest
O10_build.project_tests: No web_client route tests found (no tests/test_*web* at pinned commit); fix diff adds no tests.

j.j_sites_touched: src/khoj/routers/web_client.py (21c51b9); 9801ffd also touches src/khoj/utils/constants.py and adds src/khoj/interface/web/home/* but is the introducing commit
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject file_path containing '..' with a string check, or use os.path.normpath without a containment check (misses symlinks)

out_of_scope_notes: src/khoj/routers/api.py:122-136 writes uploaded audio to a CWD-relative temp filename built from user uuid + uuid4; not user-controlled path, unrelated to this sink.
